column1: # Bounds (every config): one host, two sandboxes, Deadline 2 ticks, Window 4, the clock to 6, two writes,
# at most one failed suspend, one wake and one repeated operator drain. ci: each under 10 s with 4 workers (TLC v1.7.4).
# The code as read at e655ace: a spot drain and an operator's, with a failed suspend
# A stale incarnation whose retirement FleetDO hears of: reaped at once, the host retired in time
# One it never hears of (use1, 2026-11-18 16:03): the salvage window outlasts the notice, and AWS takes an empty host
# Suspected: a wake between a suspended lease's eviction and SandboxDO hearing of it resumes the VM off its lease
# Fix shapes: counting an unanswered resume as busy doesn't close it; recording the evicted incarnation stale does,
# for the retirement (the refused salvage stays)
# Mutations: each guard removed must be caught
# Reachability: each state happens (so the configs above aren't vacuous)
